name: Conquistador (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
Armed with steel and clad for war, conquistadors seek conquest over large territories. With their deity as their ally, they claim lands and entire peoples as their fiefs to rule over. Rare is the conquistador who desires peace, for they see themselves as knightly champions of their faith, making the world a better place for their god to gaze upon.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Conquistadors are proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, medium armor, and shields (except tower shields). Conquistadors are also proficient with one martial weapon of choice.

This alters weapon and armor proficiencies.

Challenge (Ex)

A conquistador gains the challenge class feature, as per the cavalier, treating her inquisitor levels as her cavalier levels.

This replaces judgment.

Order

A conquistador belongs to a prestigious (or infamous) organization of knights. Select one cavalier order. The conquistador gains the edicts and challenge ability of this order, but not the skills.

This replaces domain.

Accomplished Rider (Ex)

At 2nd level, a conquistador adds half her level on all Ride skill checks.

This replaces track.

Order Abilities

A conquistador gains the order abilities of her chosen order at levels 2, 8, and 15. This replaces cunning initiative and the teamwork feat gained at 15th level. A conquistador uses Wisdom rather than Charisma for her order abilities.

Reserved Judgment

A conquistador gains second judgment at 16th level instead of 8th level. She does not gain third judgment.
